Modern formula writes 820, and the same article gives 275546/336 = 820.8; both are less precise or internally conflicting with received full coefficient.

received_formula_scope.input_combination: Sign-sensitive 盈縮差 +/- 遲疾差; source text labels same/different name and additive/subtractive outcome.
received_formula_scope.relative_denominator: source 遲疾限行度 - 0.082008 [degree-place transcription normalization]
received_formula_scope.arithmetic_precision: positive result truncated (floor) to two decimal places, not conventional half-up rounding
received_formula_scope.caution: The 820.08 factor and 0.082008 subtrahend are different numeric/unit coordinates. Do not identify them as numerically equal or claim source-original unit glyph authorization.

integer_replay.check: For A with six fractional digits, N=A*820.08 has eight fractional digits. Store N*1e8 as an integer and D*1e6 as an integer; integer floor(Nint / Dint) equals truncated result in hundredths.
integer_replay.assertions: All four printed two-place outcomes reproduce exactly under 820.08 and the same source-normalized denominator; each source's positive numerator is also exactly A*820.08.

aks_forward_erratum.judgment: AKS 820.8 is an internal displayed arithmetic inconsistency. Independently, received examples use 820.08 and reproduce their four published results. A dropped zero in AKS is plausible but unproven; AKS's broad 820 formula may be intentional low-precision shorthand. Do not treat 820, 820.08 and 820.8 as automatically interchangeable.
aks_forward_erratum.mechanical_independence: The original two-denominator comparison of 13PH is preserved; this refinement concerns constant precision and source-use scope, not proof of ancient edition variants.
